## Description

UI-03 puts the existing protected invitation form in a closed native Invite member disclosure beside Members, with one Send invitation action and a Cancel GET that discards input. Native validation, allowed roles, recipient-policy text and fixed server notices remain. Last-Admin guidance explains how to invite a replacement.

Stacked on [UI-02 #264](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/264) at `614090a1`, source remains `aa8c56bb` on main `9507e751`. It includes labelled member rows, distinct counts, quiet actions and the density correction. Source/quality are unchanged from published v1. The current local Linux AMD64 image now passes at this exact head, including six complete offline groups and seven runtime cases.

All committed `.pr-impact.json` classification flags remain false. Production architecture is unchanged within Web: existing complete overviews and protected operations preserve roles, authority, recipient rules, fixed outcomes, recovery and exact help. No new public declaration, provider operation, dependency, store, script or deployment boundary is introduced.

Root accepted source/quality/checker evidence and the exact-head image result. [V2 proof and immutable history](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/8c2280a24f4fea093a2f6e5bb36637d2be22299a/review-evidence/ui-03/aa8c56bb7e195e97d2362b2c661cc63a760a5cc9/v2/README.md) retain native execution pins, Collector failure/retry chronology and v1 publication/readback.

**Overall merge status: blocked; Draft.** The complete current hosted-live group and independent exact-head human approval remain required. UI-03’s historical 28/29 missing-Revoke run and later quota diagnostic stay separate from UI-02/UI-04 quota/503 histories. Read-only quota checks establish neither a reset time nor sending availability; no new live pass or historical cause is inferred. Root records v2 publication/readback; nothing merged/deployed.
